doc.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023

title: Rare record prices and the Songs of Local History LP
summary: An aside about his long-play record selling for $199 online and a joke about selling another copy.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: That’s right. And thankfully we have so many institutions willing to support that kind of speculation and research. Because you know the more we know about our history the greater the dimensionality that it has, not demented but dimension.
And I welcome all of that.

By the way this is an aside but yesterday I was poking around and I saw your book “Songs of Local History and Events” I think it’s on the American Folk Music Library. And on Amazon they’re selling copies for $199.
This is that long-play record you’re talking about?
I’m talking about — yes that’s right.
Okay, okay now I know what you mean. They are? Well good luck to the purchaser.
If he wants to share it with me then that’s okay. I’ll tell you what, I’ll sell him another copy for the same price.
